Delete your DressYou account

DressYou is operated by [[FOUNDER: operator-identity — the company's legal name, legal form, registered address and registration number]]. An account is deleted from the app; a request by email covers people who cannot open it.

In the app

  1. Open DressYou and sign in.
  2. Open the menu, then “privacy & safety”.
  3. Choose “delete account”.
  4. Enter your password, or confirm with Apple, then confirm the deletion.

DressYou asks you to sign in again first if your last sign-in is not recent.

What deletion erases

DressYou deletes the account and everything it holds, all at once and for good: body data and measurements, photographs, wardrobe, outfits and saves, fit answers and style rules, and every linked browser. The photographs are then erased from storage.

[[FOUNDER: deletion-and-subscription — Does deleting the account cancel a running store subscription, and what is the person told before deletion?]]

What stays, and for how long

Some copies outlast the deletion for a limited time. The privacy notice, section 6, gives every period. The main ones:

  • database backups: 35 days; erased data stays in a backup until the backup ages out;
  • copies held by the image provider: up to 30 days;
  • application logs: 30 days, without tokens, signed links or request contents;
  • purchase records: kept for the period the law sets for accounting records.

Copies that others kept or shared outside DressYou, and files exported before the deletion, cannot be recalled.

Without the app

To ask for deletion without being able to open the app, write to [[FOUNDER: privacy-contact — the address that receives privacy questions and rights requests]] from the email address the account uses, and say that the request is to delete the account. DressYou may ask you to confirm that the account is yours before acting. DressYou answers within one month; for a complex request the period can be extended by two more months, and DressYou says why within the first month.
